name: Twilight Vale
summary: In Twilight Vale, beasts and furbolgs prowl the dark woods between Darkshore and Ashenvale. The southern forest marks a perilous passage from Darkshore’s tainted coast to Ashenvale’s sacred canopies.

sections.title: A Perilous Threshold
sections.body:
Twilight Vale runs south from Ameth'Aran to the Ashenvale border, where dusk hangs over Darkshore’s southern woods. Corruption has spread deep among the wildlife. Rabid bears roam beside feral nightsabers, and hostile furbolg tribes stalk the trees.

Sentinels and travelers urge you to stay on the main road. A few paces into the woods can bring a swift, deadly ambush.

faq.q: Where is the Twilight Vale located?
faq.answer: Twilight Vale lies in southern Darkshore, just south of the highborne ruins of Ameth'Aran, and reaches the pass into Ashenvale.
Rabid bears, aggressive nightsabers, and corrupted furbolgs roam the vale and attack those who enter their territory.

faq.q: Is it safe to travel through the vale?
faq.answer: The main dirt road is far safer than the underbrush. Stray from it, and feral beasts may cross your path.

faq.q: Why is the wildlife in the vale corrupted?
aliases: why are bears rabid in darkshore
faq.answer: Darkshore has suffered since the Third War, and sundering magic lingers across northern Kalimdor. Tainted water and dark magical residue have maddened wildlife and made peaceful furbolgs violent.

angles.text: As a night elf, you mourn the corruption of the southern woods’ native beasts and the fall of furbolg neighbors near Ashenvale’s threshold.
As a druid traveling between Darkshore and Ashenvale, you see the sickness afflicting the vale’s creatures and the urgent need to cleanse the land.
